subject: Adjustment request: partial capacity charge & VAT correction
messages:
From: Lina Sorensen <lina.sorensen@heliothera.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-01T08:22:00+00:00
Subject: Unexpected partial-month GPU charge + VAT handling

Hi Olga,

We noticed a line item on the December invoice (INV-20261201-HelioThera.pdf) for an additional 4 GPU 'reserved capacity' seats starting 2026-12-05. We requested the capacity increase on Dec 4, so we expected charges to be prorated from Dec 5 — but the invoice shows a full-month charge at the higher rate. Can you help correct this?

Also, we updated our EU VAT registration (new VAT ID: DK12345678) during the same week. We need the invoice to reflect the reverse-charge treatment where applicable; the current PDF still lists VAT applied. Can you confirm whether you can reissue a corrected invoice (partial-period pro rata + VAT update) and provide a short usage CSV showing token/compute split for Dec 5-31?

Attachments: screenshot_invoice_line.png (image)

Thanks,
Lina Sorensen
Head of Finance, HelioThera
billing@heliothera.com

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Lina Sorensen <lina.sorensen@heliothera.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-01T10:05:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected partial-month GPU charge + VAT handling

Hi Lina — thanks for flagging this. I pulled the invoice and the usage ledger; initial glance suggests the capacity change went through but our billing batch applied the full monthly seat price because the change occurred after the billing run closed on Dec 1. We should be able to issue a correcting credit/invoice for the partial period.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll attach the raw usage export for Dec 5–31 (compute minutes + tokens) for your review.
- Marissa (billing ops) can produce a credit note and reissue the invoice reflecting the pro-rated days.
- Rafael (tax lead) will confirm VAT reverse-charge handling and reissue the invoice with your new VAT ID if eligible.

Can you confirm the exact date the VAT ID became active and paste the registration docs or confirmation? If it's effective Dec 6 we can apply it for the corrected invoice; if it's retroactive to Dec 1 we may need to combine with the credit.

I'll loop Ben in if we need any expedited approvals for a manual adjustment.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, Lina Sorensen <lina.sorensen@heliothera.com>
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-02T09:40:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected partial-month GPU charge + VAT handling

Thanks for the heads up. I've pulled the billing batch logs — the Dec 1 invoice was generated at 00:12 UTC before capacity changes were committed on Dec 4, so the full-month charge is indeed our fault. I can prepare a credit for the overcharged portion and reissue an invoice that charges Dec 5–31 pro rata for the 4 additional seats.

Deliverables from Billing Ops:
- Credit note: CR-20261205-HelioThera.pdf (will offset INV-20261201)
- Reissued invoice: INV-20261205-HelioThera.pdf
- CSV: usage_breakdown_202612.csv (compute minutes and token counts by day)

Estimated timeline: I can produce the docs within 48 hours, but Rafael needs to confirm VAT treatment before I finalize the reissue.

Marissa
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: billing_batch_log_excerpt.txt (text)

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, Lina Sorensen <lina.sorensen@heliothera.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T14:12:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected partial-month GPU charge + VAT handling

Hi Lina — quick note from tax: with a valid EU VAT ID we typically apply reverse-charge (0% VAT) for business-to-business supplies where both parties are VAT-registered. I checked the VAT number you provided (DK12345678) against the VIES snapshot; could you please confirm the exact activation date and paste the official VAT registration PDF? If the VAT ID was active as of Dec 6, we will:

- Reissue INV-20261205 with reverse-charge wording and zero-rate VAT for the reissued period (Dec 5–31).
- Apply the credit CR-20261205 to offset the original invoice.

If the VAT ID was effective earlier (e.g., Dec 1), we can reissue both the original and corrected invoices with reverse-charge for the full month and then apply only usage-level credits if needed.

Rafael Mendes
Tax & Compliance, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

From: Lina Sorensen <lina.sorensen@heliothera.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-07T15:03:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected partial-month GPU charge + VAT handling

Thanks, everyone — confirmed: our VAT ID DK12345678 was activated on 2026-12-06 (attached registration_confirmation_DK12345678.pdf). We accept the proposed workflow (credit + reissued invoice, reverse-charge for the reissued invoice). Please send the corrected invoice and credit note to billing@heliothera.com and copy our AP team at ap@heliothera.com.

One request: can the reissued invoice include a one-line usage summary (date range + total compute minutes for the increased capacity) to help our AP process the credit quickly? That'll avoid a separate reconciliation step.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lina

Attachments: registration_confirmation_DK12345678.pdf (pdf)
